+"""Bounded, priority-aware event backlog for the engine scheduler.
+
+The backlog deliberately owns classification.  Producers submit an event, not a
+priority, so safety-sensitive event types cannot accidentally be made lossy.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+from collections import OrderedDict
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from enum import StrEnum
+from time import monotonic
+
+from mike_trade.scheduling.scheduler import (
+    DueEvaluation,
+    ManualEvaluationRequest,
+    MarketDataArrivalEvent,
+    QuoteChangeEvent,
+)
+
+__all__ = [
+    "EventClass",
+    "EventBacklogStats",
+    "EventBacklog",
+    "BoundedEventBacklog",
+    "classify_event",
+]
+
+
+class EventClass(StrEnum):
+    CRITICAL = "CRITICAL"
+    COALESCIBLE = "COALESCIBLE"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class EventBacklogStats:
+    depth: int
+    critical_depth: int
+    coalescible_depth: int
+    oldest_age_seconds: float
+    coalesced: int
+    discarded: int
+    backpressure: int
+    overflow: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Queued:
+    event: object
+    enqueued_at: float
+
+
+_COALESCIBLE_TYPES = (MarketDataArrivalEvent, QuoteChangeEvent, DueEvaluation,
+                      ManualEvaluationRequest)
+_CRITICAL_TYPE_NAMES = frozenset(
+    {
+        "FillEvent",
+        "OrderUpdateEvent",
+        "TradeUpdate",
+        "BrokerOrderUpdate",
+        "BrokerTradeUpdate",
+        "ReconciliationEvent",
+        "ReconciliationRequest",
+        "ReconciliationDrift",
+        "StopEvent",
+        "StopTriggeredEvent",
+        "ProtectiveEvent",
+        "ProtectionEvent",
+        "SafetyExitEvent",
+        "ManualCloseEvent",
+    }
+)
+_CRITICAL_NAME_PARTS = ("fill", "brokerorder", "brokertrade", "reconcil", "stop",
+                        "protect", "safetyexit", "manualclose")
+
+
+def classify_event(event: object) -> EventClass:
+    """Classify from the concrete event type; callers cannot supply a class."""
+
+    if isinstance(event, _COALESCIBLE_TYPES):
+        return EventClass.COALESCIBLE
+
+    type_name = type(event).__name__
+    normalized = "".join(character for character in type_name.lower() if character.isalnum())
+    if type_name in _CRITICAL_TYPE_NAMES or any(
+        part in normalized for part in _CRITICAL_NAME_PARTS
+    ):
+        return EventClass.CRITICAL
+
+    # Operator close/flatten/reconcile commands are critical.  Other control
+    # commands are intentionally not guessed into either delivery class.
+    command_type = getattr(event, "command_type", None)
+    command_name = str(getattr(command_type, "value", command_type)).upper()
+    if command_name in {"CLOSE_POSITION", "CLOSE_ALL", "FLATTEN", "RECONCILE_NOW"}:
+        return EventClass.CRITICAL
+
+    raise TypeError(f"unsupported scheduling event type: {type(event).__module__}.{type_name}")
+
+
+def _text(value: object) -> str:
+    return str(getattr(value, "value", value))
+
+
+def _coalescing_key(event: object) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
+    symbol = getattr(event, "symbol", None)
+    strategy_id = getattr(event, "strategy_id", "*")
+    side = getattr(event, "side", "*")
+    if not isinstance(symbol, str) or not symbol.strip():
+        raise ValueError("coalescible events require a symbol")
+    return (symbol.strip().upper(), _text(strategy_id), _text(side))
+
+
+def _snapshot_version(event: object) -> int:
+    version = getattr(event, "snapshot_version", None)
+    if isinstance(version, bool) or not isinstance(version, int) or version < 1:
+        raise ValueError("coalescible events require a positive snapshot_version")
+    return version
+
+
+class EventBacklog:
+    """Two-class bounded asynchronous backlog.
+
+    Critical FIFO capacity and coalescible-key capacity are independently
+    bounded.  Critical puts wait when full.  A coalescible put replaces the
+    pending item for its key, while a new key waits if the key capacity is full.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, *, critical_maxsize: int = 128, coalescible_maxsize: int = 128) -> None:
+        if isinstance(critical_maxsize, bool) or critical_maxsize < 1:
+            raise ValueError("critical_maxsize must be a positive integer")
+        if isinstance(coalescible_maxsize, bool) or coalescible_maxsize < 1:
+            raise ValueError("coalescible_maxsize must be a positive integer")
+        self._critical: asyncio.Queue[_Queued] = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=critical_maxsize)
+        self._coalescible_maxsize = coalescible_maxsize
+        self._coalescible: OrderedDict[tuple[str, str, str], _Queued] = OrderedDict()
+        self._watermarks: dict[str, int] = {}
+        self._changed = asyncio.Event()
+        self._space = asyncio.Condition()
+        self._coalesced = 0
+        self._discarded = 0
+        self._backpressure = 0
+        self._overflow = 0
+
+    @property
+    def critical_maxsize(self) -> int:
+        return self._critical.maxsize
+
+    @property
+    def coalescible_maxsize(self) -> int:
+        return self._coalescible_maxsize
+
+    @property
+    def watermarks(self) -> dict[str, int]:
+        return dict(self._watermarks)
+
+    def watermark(self, symbol: str) -> int | None:
+        return self._watermarks.get(symbol.strip().upper())
+
+    def qsize(self) -> int:
+        return self._critical.qsize() + len(self._coalescible)
+
+    def empty(self) -> bool:
+        return self.qsize() == 0
+
+    @property
+    def stats(self) -> EventBacklogStats:
+        now = monotonic()
+        timestamps = [item.enqueued_at for item in tuple(self._critical._queue)]  # noqa: SLF001
+        timestamps.extend(item.enqueued_at for item in self._coalescible.values())
+        return EventBacklogStats(
+            depth=self.qsize(),
+            critical_depth=self._critical.qsize(),
+            coalescible_depth=len(self._coalescible),
+            oldest_age_seconds=max(0.0, now - min(timestamps)) if timestamps else 0.0,
+            coalesced=self._coalesced,
+            discarded=self._discarded,
+            backpressure=self._backpressure,
+            overflow=self._overflow,
+        )
+
+    def health(self) -> EventBacklogStats:
+        return self.stats
+
+    async def put(self, event: object) -> bool:
+        """Enqueue *event*; return False only for an obsolete snapshot."""
+
+        event_class = classify_event(event)
+        if event_class is EventClass.CRITICAL:
+            if self._critical.full():
+                self._backpressure += 1
+                self._overflow += 1
+            await self._critical.put(_Queued(event, monotonic()))
+            self._changed.set()
+            return True
+
+        key = _coalescing_key(event)
+        version = _snapshot_version(event)
+        symbol = key[0]
+        watermark = self._watermarks.get(symbol, 0)
+        current = self._coalescible.get(key)
+        current_version = _snapshot_version(current.event) if current is not None else 0
+        if version < max(watermark, current_version):
+            self._discarded += 1
+            return False
+        self._watermarks[symbol] = max(watermark, version)
+
+        if current is not None:
+            if version == current_version:
+                self._discarded += 1
+                return False
+            self._coalescible[key] = _Queued(event, monotonic())
+            self._coalesced += 1
+            self._changed.set()
+            return True
+
+        async with self._space:
+            if len(self._coalescible) >= self._coalescible_maxsize:
+                self._backpressure += 1
+                self._overflow += 1
+            await self._space.wait_for(
+                lambda: len(self._coalescible) < self._coalescible_maxsize
+            )
+            # Another producer may have installed this key while we waited.
+            current = self._coalescible.get(key)
+            if current is not None:
+                current_version = _snapshot_version(current.event)
+                if version <= current_version:
+                    self._discarded += 1
+                    return False
+                self._coalesced += 1
+            self._coalescible[key] = _Queued(event, monotonic())
+        self._changed.set()
+        return True
+
+    async def get(self) -> object:
+        """Return the next item, always draining safety-critical FIFO work first."""
+
+        while True:
+            try:
+                queued = self._critical.get_nowait()
+                if self.empty():
+                    self._changed.clear()
+                return queued.event
+            except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
+                pass
+
+            async with self._space:
+                if self._coalescible:
+                    _, queued = self._coalescible.popitem(last=False)
+                    self._space.notify(1)
+                    if self.empty():
+                        self._changed.clear()
+                    return queued.event
+
+            self._changed.clear()
+            if not self.empty():
+                self._changed.set()
+                continue
+            await self._changed.wait()
+
+    def task_done(self) -> None:
+        """Mark one critical item complete when consumers use queue joins."""
+
+        self._critical.task_done()
+
+    async def join_critical(self) -> None:
+        await self._critical.join()
+
+
+BoundedEventBacklog = EventBacklog

+"""Bounded, broker-neutral execution of strategy evaluations."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import concurrent.futures
+import functools
+import threading
+import traceback
+from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from enum import StrEnum
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.domain.strategy_types import Evaluation, EvaluationStatus, StrategyRole
+from mike_trade.scheduling.scheduler import DueEvaluation
+
+__all__ = [
+    "EvaluationOutcome",
+    "EvaluationResult",
+    "EvaluationPoolClosedError",
+    "EvaluationPool",
+]
+
+
+class EvaluationOutcome(StrEnum):
+    SIGNAL = "SIGNAL"
+    NO_SIGNAL = "NO_SIGNAL"
+    ERROR = "ERROR"
+    TIMEOUT = "TIMEOUT"
+    CANCELLED = "CANCELLED"
+    STALE_DISCARDED = "STALE_DISCARDED"
+
+
+_NON_SIGNAL_OUTCOMES = frozenset(
+    {
+        EvaluationOutcome.NO_SIGNAL,
+        EvaluationOutcome.ERROR,
+        EvaluationOutcome.TIMEOUT,
+        EvaluationOutcome.CANCELLED,
+        EvaluationOutcome.STALE_DISCARDED,
+    }
+)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class EvaluationResult:
+    strategy_id: str
+    side: StrategyRole
+    symbol: str
+    snapshot_version: int | None
+    started_at: datetime
+    finished_at: datetime
+    outcome: EvaluationOutcome
+    signal: object | None = None
+    error_detail: str | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        for name in ("started_at", "finished_at"):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware")
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, value.astimezone(UTC))
+        if self.finished_at < self.started_at:
+            raise ValueError("finished_at must not precede started_at")
+        if self.outcome is EvaluationOutcome.SIGNAL:
+            if self.signal is None:
+                raise ValueError("SIGNAL outcomes require a signal payload")
+        elif self.signal is not None:
+            raise ValueError(f"{self.outcome.value} outcomes must not carry a signal")
+        if self.outcome is EvaluationOutcome.ERROR and not self.error_detail:
+            raise ValueError("ERROR outcomes require error_detail")
+
+    @property
+    def actionable(self) -> bool:
+        return self.outcome is EvaluationOutcome.SIGNAL
+
+    @property
+    def reason(self) -> str | None:
+        return self.error_detail
+
+
+class EvaluationPoolClosedError(RuntimeError):
+    """Raised when work is submitted after graceful shutdown begins."""
+
+
+@dataclass(eq=False, slots=True)
+class _Pending:
+    key: tuple[str, str, str]
+    version: int | None
+    superseded: asyncio.Event = field(default_factory=asyncio.Event)
+
+
+def _call(evaluator: Callable[..., object], args: tuple[object, ...],
+          kwargs: Mapping[str, object]) -> object:
+    return evaluator(*args, **kwargs)
+
+
+class EvaluationPool:
+    """One shared, bounded executor pool for all symbols and strategies."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        max_workers: int = 4,
+        max_in_flight: int | None = None,
+        evaluation_timeout: float = 5.0,
+        shutdown_timeout: float = 10.0,
+        enable_process_pool: bool = False,
+        process_workers: int | None = None,
+        thread_name_prefix: str = "strategy-evaluation",
+    ) -> None:
+        self._require_positive_int(max_workers, "max_workers")
+        cap = max_workers if max_in_flight is None else max_in_flight
+        self._require_positive_int(cap, "max_in_flight")
+        self._require_positive_seconds(evaluation_timeout, "evaluation_timeout")
+        self._require_positive_seconds(shutdown_timeout, "shutdown_timeout")
+        if not isinstance(enable_process_pool, bool):
+            raise ValueError("enable_process_pool must be bool")
+        if process_workers is not None:
+            self._require_positive_int(process_workers, "process_workers")
+
+        self._thread_executor = concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(
+            max_workers=max_workers, thread_name_prefix=thread_name_prefix
+        )
+        self._process_executor: concurrent.futures.ProcessPoolExecutor | None = None
+        self._process_workers = process_workers or max(1, min(2, max_workers))
+        self._process_enabled = enable_process_pool
+        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(cap)
+        self._max_workers = max_workers
+        self._max_in_flight = cap
+        self._evaluation_timeout = float(evaluation_timeout)
+        self._shutdown_timeout = float(shutdown_timeout)
+        self._accepting = True
+        self._shutdown_complete = False
+        self._watermarks: dict[tuple[str, str, str], int] = {}
+        self._pending: dict[tuple[str, str, str], set[_Pending]] = {}

+    @staticmethod

+            return False

+    async def _monitor_future(self, future: concurrent.futures.Future[object]) -> None:

+    @staticmethod

+                future.cancel()
+        finally:

+            if self._process_executor is not None:
+                self._process_executor.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)

+    async def __aenter__(self) -> EvaluationPool:
+        return self
+
+    async def __aexit__(self, exc_type: object, exc: object, tb: object) -> None:
+        await self.shutdown()

+"""Backpressure and bounded strategy-worker contract tests."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import threading
+import time
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.domain.strategy_types import StrategyRole
+from mike_trade.scheduling.queueing import EventBacklog
+from mike_trade.scheduling.scheduler import DueEvaluation
+from mike_trade.scheduling.triggers import TriggerKind
+from mike_trade.scheduling.workers import (
+    EvaluationOutcome,
+    EvaluationPool,
+    EvaluationPoolClosedError,
+)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class FillEvent:
+    sequence: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class BrokerOrderUpdate:
+    sequence: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class StopEvent:
+    sequence: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ReconciliationEvent:
+    sequence: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class SafetyExitEvent:
+    sequence: int
+
+
+def due(version: int, *, symbol: str = "AAPL", strategy: str = "alpha") -> DueEvaluation:
+    return DueEvaluation(
+        symbol=symbol,
+        strategy_id=strategy,
+        side=StrategyRole.BUY,
+        trigger_kind=TriggerKind.MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL,
+        snapshot_version=version,
+        bar_key=None,
+        due_at=datetime.now(UTC),
+    )
+
+
+async def test_snapshot_flood_keeps_only_latest_version() -> None:
+    backlog = EventBacklog(critical_maxsize=1, coalescible_maxsize=1)
+    for version in range(1, 101):
+        assert await backlog.put(due(version))
+
+    assert backlog.qsize() == 1
+    assert (await backlog.get()).snapshot_version == 100
+    assert backlog.stats.coalesced == 99
+    assert backlog.watermark("AAPL") == 100
+
+
+async def test_critical_events_survive_market_data_flood_in_fifo_order() -> None:
+    backlog = EventBacklog(critical_maxsize=2, coalescible_maxsize=1)
+    events = [FillEvent(1), BrokerOrderUpdate(2), StopEvent(3),
+              ReconciliationEvent(4), SafetyExitEvent(5)]
+    received: list[object] = []
+
+    async def consume() -> None:
+        while len([item for item in received if not isinstance(item, DueEvaluation)]) < 5:
+            received.append(await backlog.get())
+
+    consumer = asyncio.create_task(consume())
+    for version, event in enumerate(events, 1):
+        await backlog.put(due(version))
+        await backlog.put(event)
+    await consumer
+
+    critical = [item for item in received if not isinstance(item, DueEvaluation)]
+    assert critical == events
+    assert backlog.stats.coalesced + backlog.stats.discarded >= 1
+
+
+async def test_full_critical_queue_backpressures_instead_of_dropping() -> None:
+    backlog = EventBacklog(critical_maxsize=1, coalescible_maxsize=1)
+    first, second = FillEvent(1), FillEvent(2)
+    await backlog.put(first)
+    blocked = asyncio.create_task(backlog.put(second))
+    await asyncio.sleep(0)
+    assert not blocked.done()
+    assert backlog.stats.backpressure == 1
+    assert backlog.stats.overflow == 1
+    assert await backlog.get() == first
+    assert await blocked
+    assert await backlog.get() == second
+
+
+async def test_exception_is_isolated_and_non_signal_outcomes_have_no_signal() -> None:
+    pool = EvaluationPool(max_workers=2, evaluation_timeout=0.05)
+
+    def broken() -> object:
+        raise RuntimeError("deliberate failure")
+
+    results = await asyncio.gather(
+        pool.submit(due(1), broken),
+        pool.submit(due(1, strategy="ok"), lambda: {"side": "BUY"}),
+    )
+    error, normal = results
+    assert error.outcome is EvaluationOutcome.ERROR
+    assert "deliberate failure" in (error.error_detail or "")
+    assert error.signal is None
+    assert normal.outcome is EvaluationOutcome.SIGNAL
+
+    timeout = await pool.submit(due(2), lambda: time.sleep(0.2), timeout=0.01)
+    assert timeout.outcome is EvaluationOutcome.TIMEOUT
+    assert timeout.signal is None
+    await pool.shutdown(timeout=0.01)
+
+
+async def test_stale_completion_and_pending_supersession() -> None:
+    pool = EvaluationPool(max_workers=1, evaluation_timeout=1)
+    started = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+
+    def slow() -> str:
+        started.set()
+        release.wait(0.5)
+        return "BUY"
+
+    first = asyncio.create_task(pool.submit(due(1), slow))
+    await asyncio.to_thread(started.wait, 0.2)
+    pending = asyncio.create_task(pool.submit(due(1, strategy="pending"), lambda: "BUY"))
+    await asyncio.sleep(0)
+    pool.update_watermark("AAPL", "alpha", StrategyRole.BUY, 2)
+    pool.update_watermark("AAPL", "pending", StrategyRole.BUY, 2)
+    release.set()
+
+    stale, cancelled = await asyncio.gather(first, pending)
+    assert stale.outcome is EvaluationOutcome.STALE_DISCARDED
+    assert stale.signal is None
+    assert cancelled.outcome is EvaluationOutcome.CANCELLED
+    assert cancelled.signal is None
+    await pool.shutdown()
+
+
+async def test_shared_executor_and_concurrency_cap() -> None:
+    pool = EvaluationPool(max_workers=2, max_in_flight=2)
+    executor_id = id(pool.executor)
+    lock = threading.Lock()
+    active = high_water = 0
+
+    def evaluate() -> None:
+        nonlocal active, high_water
+        with lock:
+            active += 1
+            high_water = max(high_water, active)
+        time.sleep(0.01)
+        with lock:
+            active -= 1
+
+    jobs = [pool.submit(due(1, symbol=f"S{symbol}", strategy=f"s{strategy}"), evaluate)
+            for symbol in range(10) for strategy in range(3)]
+    await asyncio.gather(*jobs)
+    assert high_water <= 2
+    assert pool.in_flight_high_water <= 2
+    assert id(pool.executor) == executor_id
+    assert pool.thread_submissions == 30
+    await pool.shutdown()
+
+
+async def test_process_execution_is_explicit_and_disabled_by_default() -> None:
+    class CpuHeavy:
+        cpu_heavy = True
+
+        def evaluate(self) -> None:
+            return None
+
+    disabled = EvaluationPool(max_workers=1)
+    await disabled.submit(due(1), CpuHeavy())
+    assert disabled.process_executor is None
+    assert disabled.process_submissions == 0
+    await disabled.shutdown()
+
+    # Selection itself is covered without making this unit test depend on a
+    # platform-specific process start method or pickling a local fixture.
+    enabled = EvaluationPool(max_workers=1, enable_process_pool=True)
+    evaluator = enabled._resolve_evaluator(CpuHeavy())
+    selected = enabled._select_executor(CpuHeavy(), evaluator)
+    assert selected is enabled.process_executor
+    await enabled.shutdown()
+
+
+async def test_shutdown_is_bounded_and_rejects_new_work() -> None:
+    pool = EvaluationPool(max_workers=1, evaluation_timeout=0.02, shutdown_timeout=0.05)
+    running = asyncio.create_task(pool.submit(due(1), lambda: time.sleep(0.2)))
+    await asyncio.sleep(0)
+    await pool.shutdown()
+    result = await running
+    assert result.outcome is EvaluationOutcome.TIMEOUT
+    with pytest.raises(EvaluationPoolClosedError):
+        await pool.submit(due(2), lambda: None)

+"""Bounded, priority-aware event backlog for the engine scheduler.
+
+The backlog deliberately owns classification.  Producers submit an event, not a
+priority, so safety-sensitive event types cannot accidentally be made lossy.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+from collections import OrderedDict
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from enum import StrEnum
+from time import monotonic
+
+from mike_trade.scheduling.scheduler import (
+    DueEvaluation,
+    ManualEvaluationRequest,
+    MarketDataArrivalEvent,
+    QuoteChangeEvent,
+)
+
+__all__ = [
+    "EventClass",
+    "EventBacklogStats",
+    "EventBacklog",
+    "BoundedEventBacklog",
+    "classify_event",
+]
+
+
+class EventClass(StrEnum):
+    CRITICAL = "CRITICAL"
+    COALESCIBLE = "COALESCIBLE"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class EventBacklogStats:
+    depth: int
+    critical_depth: int
+    coalescible_depth: int
+    oldest_age_seconds: float
+    coalesced: int
+    discarded: int
+    backpressure: int
+    overflow: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Queued:
+    event: object
+    enqueued_at: float
+
+
+_COALESCIBLE_TYPES = (MarketDataArrivalEvent, QuoteChangeEvent, DueEvaluation,
+                      ManualEvaluationRequest)
+_CRITICAL_TYPE_NAMES = frozenset(
+    {
+        "FillEvent",
+        "OrderUpdateEvent",
+        "TradeUpdate",
+        "BrokerOrderUpdate",
+        "BrokerTradeUpdate",
+        "ReconciliationEvent",
+        "ReconciliationRequest",
+        "ReconciliationDrift",
+        "StopEvent",
+        "StopTriggeredEvent",
+        "ProtectiveEvent",
+        "ProtectionEvent",
+        "SafetyExitEvent",
+        "ManualCloseEvent",
+    }
+)
+_CRITICAL_NAME_PARTS = ("fill", "brokerorder", "brokertrade", "reconcil", "stop",
+                        "protect", "safetyexit", "manualclose")
+
+
+def classify_event(event: object) -> EventClass:
+    """Classify from the concrete event type; callers cannot supply a class."""
+
+    if isinstance(event, _COALESCIBLE_TYPES):
+        return EventClass.COALESCIBLE
+
+    type_name = type(event).__name__
+    normalized = "".join(character for character in type_name.lower() if character.isalnum())
+    if type_name in _CRITICAL_TYPE_NAMES or any(
+        part in normalized for part in _CRITICAL_NAME_PARTS
+    ):
+        return EventClass.CRITICAL
+
+    # Operator close/flatten/reconcile commands are critical.  Other control
+    # commands are intentionally not guessed into either delivery class.
+    command_type = getattr(event, "command_type", None)
+    command_name = str(getattr(command_type, "value", command_type)).upper()
+    if command_name in {"CLOSE_POSITION", "CLOSE_ALL", "FLATTEN", "RECONCILE_NOW"}:
+        return EventClass.CRITICAL
+
+    raise TypeError(f"unsupported scheduling event type: {type(event).__module__}.{type_name}")
+
+
+def _text(value: object) -> str:
+    return str(getattr(value, "value", value))
+
+
+def _coalescing_key(event: object) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
+    symbol = getattr(event, "symbol", None)
+    strategy_id = getattr(event, "strategy_id", "*")
+    side = getattr(event, "side", "*")
+    if not isinstance(symbol, str) or not symbol.strip():
+        raise ValueError("coalescible events require a symbol")
+    return (symbol.strip().upper(), _text(strategy_id), _text(side))
+
+
+def _snapshot_version(event: object) -> int:
+    version = getattr(event, "snapshot_version", None)
+    if isinstance(version, bool) or not isinstance(version, int) or version < 1:
+        raise ValueError("coalescible events require a positive snapshot_version")
+    return version
+
+
+class EventBacklog:
+    """Two-class bounded asynchronous backlog.
+
+    Critical FIFO capacity and coalescible-key capacity are independently
+    bounded.  Critical puts wait when full.  A coalescible put replaces the
+    pending item for its key, while a new key waits if the key capacity is full.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, *, critical_maxsize: int = 128, coalescible_maxsize: int = 128) -> None:
+        if isinstance(critical_maxsize, bool) or critical_maxsize < 1:
+            raise ValueError("critical_maxsize must be a positive integer")
+        if isinstance(coalescible_maxsize, bool) or coalescible_maxsize < 1:
+            raise ValueError("coalescible_maxsize must be a positive integer")
+        self._critical: asyncio.Queue[_Queued] = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=critical_maxsize)
+        self._coalescible_maxsize = coalescible_maxsize
+        self._coalescible: OrderedDict[tuple[str, str, str], _Queued] = OrderedDict()
+        self._watermarks: dict[str, int] = {}
+        self._changed = asyncio.Event()
+        self._space = asyncio.Condition()
+        self._coalesced = 0
+        self._discarded = 0
+        self._backpressure = 0
+        self._overflow = 0
+
+    @property
+    def critical_maxsize(self) -> int:
+        return self._critical.maxsize
+
+    @property
+    def coalescible_maxsize(self) -> int:
+        return self._coalescible_maxsize
+
+    @property
+    def watermarks(self) -> dict[str, int]:
+        return dict(self._watermarks)
+
+    def watermark(self, symbol: str) -> int | None:
+        return self._watermarks.get(symbol.strip().upper())
+
+    def qsize(self) -> int:
+        return self._critical.qsize() + len(self._coalescible)
+
+    def empty(self) -> bool:
+        return self.qsize() == 0
+
+    @property
+    def stats(self) -> EventBacklogStats:
+        now = monotonic()
+        timestamps = [item.enqueued_at for item in tuple(self._critical._queue)]  # noqa: SLF001
+        timestamps.extend(item.enqueued_at for item in self._coalescible.values())
+        return EventBacklogStats(
+            depth=self.qsize(),
+            critical_depth=self._critical.qsize(),
+            coalescible_depth=len(self._coalescible),
+            oldest_age_seconds=max(0.0, now - min(timestamps)) if timestamps else 0.0,
+            coalesced=self._coalesced,
+            discarded=self._discarded,
+            backpressure=self._backpressure,
+            overflow=self._overflow,
+        )
+
+    def health(self) -> EventBacklogStats:
+        return self.stats
+
+    async def put(self, event: object) -> bool:
+        """Enqueue *event*; return False only for an obsolete snapshot."""
+
+        event_class = classify_event(event)
+        if event_class is EventClass.CRITICAL:
+            if self._critical.full():
+                self._backpressure += 1
+                self._overflow += 1
+            await self._critical.put(_Queued(event, monotonic()))
+            self._changed.set()
+            return True
+
+        key = _coalescing_key(event)
+        version = _snapshot_version(event)
+        symbol = key[0]
+        watermark = self._watermarks.get(symbol, 0)
+        current = self._coalescible.get(key)
+        current_version = _snapshot_version(current.event) if current is not None else 0
+        if version < max(watermark, current_version):
+            self._discarded += 1
+            return False
+        self._watermarks[symbol] = max(watermark, version)
+
+        if current is not None:
+            if version == current_version:
+                self._discarded += 1
+                return False
+            self._coalescible[key] = _Queued(event, monotonic())
+            self._coalesced += 1
+            self._changed.set()
+            return True
+
+        async with self._space:
+            if len(self._coalescible) >= self._coalescible_maxsize:
+                self._backpressure += 1
+                self._overflow += 1
+            await self._space.wait_for(
+                lambda: len(self._coalescible) < self._coalescible_maxsize
+            )
+            # Another producer may have installed this key while we waited.
+            current = self._coalescible.get(key)
+            if current is not None:
+                current_version = _snapshot_version(current.event)
+                if version <= current_version:
+                    self._discarded += 1
+                    return False
+                self._coalesced += 1
+            self._coalescible[key] = _Queued(event, monotonic())
+        self._changed.set()
+        return True
+
+    async def get(self) -> object:
+        """Return the next item, always draining safety-critical FIFO work first."""
+
+        while True:
+            try:
+                queued = self._critical.get_nowait()
+                if self.empty():
+                    self._changed.clear()
+                return queued.event
+            except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
+                pass
+
+            async with self._space:
+                if self._coalescible:
+                    _, queued = self._coalescible.popitem(last=False)
+                    self._space.notify(1)
+                    if self.empty():
+                        self._changed.clear()
+                    return queued.event
+
+            self._changed.clear()
+            if not self.empty():
+                self._changed.set()
+                continue
+            await self._changed.wait()
+
+    def task_done(self) -> None:
+        """Mark one critical item complete when consumers use queue joins."""
+
+        self._critical.task_done()
+
+    async def join_critical(self) -> None:
+        await self._critical.join()
+
+
+BoundedEventBacklog = EventBacklog

+"""Bounded, broker-neutral execution of strategy evaluations."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import concurrent.futures
+import functools
+import threading
+import traceback
+from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from enum import StrEnum
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.domain.strategy_types import Evaluation, EvaluationStatus, StrategyRole
+from mike_trade.scheduling.scheduler import DueEvaluation
+
+__all__ = [
+    "EvaluationOutcome",
+    "EvaluationResult",
+    "EvaluationPoolClosedError",
+    "EvaluationPool",
+]
+
+
+class EvaluationOutcome(StrEnum):
+    SIGNAL = "SIGNAL"
+    NO_SIGNAL = "NO_SIGNAL"
+    ERROR = "ERROR"
+    TIMEOUT = "TIMEOUT"
+    CANCELLED = "CANCELLED"
+    STALE_DISCARDED = "STALE_DISCARDED"
+
+
+_NON_SIGNAL_OUTCOMES = frozenset(
+    {
+        EvaluationOutcome.NO_SIGNAL,
+        EvaluationOutcome.ERROR,
+        EvaluationOutcome.TIMEOUT,
+        EvaluationOutcome.CANCELLED,
+        EvaluationOutcome.STALE_DISCARDED,
+    }
+)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class EvaluationResult:
+    strategy_id: str
+    side: StrategyRole
+    symbol: str
+    snapshot_version: int | None
+    started_at: datetime
+    finished_at: datetime
+    outcome: EvaluationOutcome
+    signal: object | None = None
+    error_detail: str | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        for name in ("started_at", "finished_at"):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware")
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, value.astimezone(UTC))
+        if self.finished_at < self.started_at:
+            raise ValueError("finished_at must not precede started_at")
+        if self.outcome is EvaluationOutcome.SIGNAL:
+            if self.signal is None:
+                raise ValueError("SIGNAL outcomes require a signal payload")
+        elif self.signal is not None:
+            raise ValueError(f"{self.outcome.value} outcomes must not carry a signal")
+        if self.outcome is EvaluationOutcome.ERROR and not self.error_detail:
+            raise ValueError("ERROR outcomes require error_detail")
+
+    @property
+    def actionable(self) -> bool:
+        return self.outcome is EvaluationOutcome.SIGNAL
+
+    @property
+    def reason(self) -> str | None:
+        return self.error_detail
+
+
+class EvaluationPoolClosedError(RuntimeError):
+    """Raised when work is submitted after graceful shutdown begins."""
+
+
+@dataclass(eq=False, slots=True)
+class _Pending:
+    key: tuple[str, str, str]
+    version: int | None
+    superseded: asyncio.Event = field(default_factory=asyncio.Event)
+
+
+def _call(evaluator: Callable[..., object], args: tuple[object, ...],
+          kwargs: Mapping[str, object]) -> object:
+    return evaluator(*args, **kwargs)
+
+
+class EvaluationPool:
+    """One shared, bounded executor pool for all symbols and strategies."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        max_workers: int = 4,
+        max_in_flight: int | None = None,
+        evaluation_timeout: float = 5.0,
+        shutdown_timeout: float = 10.0,
+        enable_process_pool: bool = False,
+        process_workers: int | None = None,
+        thread_name_prefix: str = "strategy-evaluation",
+    ) -> None:
+        self._require_positive_int(max_workers, "max_workers")
+        cap = max_workers if max_in_flight is None else max_in_flight
+        self._require_positive_int(cap, "max_in_flight")
+        self._require_positive_seconds(evaluation_timeout, "evaluation_timeout")
+        self._require_positive_seconds(shutdown_timeout, "shutdown_timeout")
+        if not isinstance(enable_process_pool, bool):
+            raise ValueError("enable_process_pool must be bool")
+        if process_workers is not None:
+            self._require_positive_int(process_workers, "process_workers")
+
+        self._thread_executor = concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(
+            max_workers=max_workers, thread_name_prefix=thread_name_prefix
+        )
+        self._process_executor: concurrent.futures.ProcessPoolExecutor | None = None
+        self._process_workers = process_workers or max(1, min(2, max_workers))
+        self._process_enabled = enable_process_pool
+        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(cap)
+        self._max_workers = max_workers
+        self._max_in_flight = cap
+        self._evaluation_timeout = float(evaluation_timeout)
+        self._shutdown_timeout = float(shutdown_timeout)
+        self._accepting = True
+        self._shutdown_complete = False
+        self._watermarks: dict[tuple[str, str, str], int] = {}
+        self._pending: dict[tuple[str, str, str], set[_Pending]] = {}
+        self._active_submissions: set[asyncio.Task[Any]] = set()
+        self._executor_futures: set[concurrent.futures.Future[object]] = set()
+        self._monitor_tasks: set[asyncio.Task[None]] = set()
+        self._in_flight = 0
+        self._in_flight_high_water = 0
+        self._thread_submissions = 0
+        self._process_submissions = 0
+        self._counter_lock = threading.Lock()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _require_positive_int(value: object, name: str) -> None:
+        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a positive integer")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _require_positive_seconds(value: object, name: str) -> None:
+        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or value <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be positive")
+
+    @property
+    def executor(self) -> concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor:
+        return self._thread_executor
+
+    @property
+    def thread_executor(self) -> concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor:
+        return self._thread_executor
+
+    @property
+    def process_executor(self) -> concurrent.futures.ProcessPoolExecutor | None:
+        return self._process_executor
+
+    @property
+    def max_workers(self) -> int:
+        return self._max_workers
+
+    @property
+    def max_in_flight(self) -> int:
+        return self._max_in_flight
+
+    @property
+    def in_flight(self) -> int:
+        with self._counter_lock:
+            return self._in_flight
+
+    @property
+    def in_flight_high_water(self) -> int:
+        with self._counter_lock:
+            return self._in_flight_high_water
+
+    @property
+    def thread_submissions(self) -> int:
+        return self._thread_submissions
+
+    @property
+    def process_submissions(self) -> int:
+        return self._process_submissions
+
+    @property
+    def accepting(self) -> bool:
+        return self._accepting
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def evaluation_key(due: DueEvaluation) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
+        return (due.symbol, due.strategy_id, due.side.value)
+
+    def latest_snapshot_version(self, due: DueEvaluation) -> int | None:
+        return self._watermarks.get(self.evaluation_key(due))
+
+    def update_watermark(
+        self,
+        symbol: str,
+        strategy_id: str,
+        side: StrategyRole | str,
+        snapshot_version: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Record a newer snapshot and cancel work that has not started."""
+
+        if isinstance(snapshot_version, bool) or not isinstance(snapshot_version, int) \
+                or snapshot_version < 1:
+            raise ValueError("snapshot_version must be a positive integer")
+        side_text = side.value if isinstance(side, StrategyRole) else str(side).upper()
+        key = (symbol.strip().upper(), strategy_id.strip(), side_text)
+        previous = self._watermarks.get(key, 0)
+        if snapshot_version <= previous:
+            return
+        self._watermarks[key] = snapshot_version
+        for pending in self._pending.get(key, ()):
+            if pending.version is not None and pending.version < snapshot_version:
+                pending.superseded.set()
+
+    note_snapshot = update_watermark
+
+    async def submit(
+        self,
+        due: DueEvaluation,
+        strategy: object,
+        *args: object,
+        timeout: float | None = None,
+        **kwargs: object,
+    ) -> EvaluationResult:
+        """Evaluate one due item without ever running strategy code on the event loop."""
+
+        if not self._accepting:
+            raise EvaluationPoolClosedError("evaluation pool is shutting down")
+        if not isinstance(due, DueEvaluation):
+            raise TypeError("due must be DueEvaluation")
+        if timeout is not None:
+            self._require_positive_seconds(timeout, "timeout")
+        evaluator = self._resolve_evaluator(strategy)
+        key = self.evaluation_key(due)
+        pending = _Pending(key, due.snapshot_version)
+        self._pending.setdefault(key, set()).add(pending)
+        if due.snapshot_version is not None:
+            self.update_watermark(*key, due.snapshot_version)
+
+        current_task = asyncio.current_task()
+        if current_task is not None:
+            self._active_submissions.add(current_task)
+        started_at = datetime.now(UTC)
+        acquired = False
+        try:
+            acquire_task = asyncio.create_task(self._semaphore.acquire())
+            stale_task = asyncio.create_task(pending.superseded.wait())
+            done, _ = await asyncio.wait(
+                {acquire_task, stale_task}, return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED
+            )
+            if acquire_task in done:
+                acquired = True
+            if stale_task in done and pending.superseded.is_set():
+                if not acquire_task.done():
+                    acquire_task.cancel()
+                else:
+                    acquired = True
+                if acquired:
+                    self._semaphore.release()
+                return self._result(
+                    due, started_at, EvaluationOutcome.CANCELLED,
+                    error_detail="superseded before evaluation started",
+                )
+            stale_task.cancel()
+            await asyncio.gather(stale_task, return_exceptions=True)
+
+            # A newer version can arrive between semaphore acquisition and dispatch.
+            if self._is_stale(due):
+                self._semaphore.release()
+                acquired = False
+                return self._result(
+                    due, started_at, EvaluationOutcome.CANCELLED,
+                    error_detail="superseded before evaluation started",
+                )
+
+            executor = self._select_executor(strategy, evaluator)
+            call = functools.partial(_call, evaluator, args, kwargs)
+            future = executor.submit(call)
+            self._executor_futures.add(future)
+            with self._counter_lock:
+                self._in_flight += 1
+                self._in_flight_high_water = max(self._in_flight_high_water, self._in_flight)
+            if executor is self._thread_executor:
+                self._thread_submissions += 1
+            else:
+                self._process_submissions += 1
+
+            monitor = asyncio.create_task(self._monitor_future(future))
+            self._monitor_tasks.add(monitor)
+            monitor.add_done_callback(self._monitor_tasks.discard)
+            acquired = False  # completion callback now owns the permit
+            try:
+                raw = await self._await_future(
+                    future,
+                    self._evaluation_timeout if timeout is None else float(timeout),
+                )
+            except TimeoutError:
+                future.cancel()  # succeeds only if executor work has not started
+                return self._result(
+                    due, started_at, EvaluationOutcome.TIMEOUT,
+                    error_detail="strategy evaluation exceeded its timeout",
+                )
+            except asyncio.CancelledError:
+                future.cancel()
+                return self._result(
+                    due, started_at, EvaluationOutcome.CANCELLED,
+                    error_detail="evaluation was cancelled",
+                )
+            except Exception as exc:  # strategy failures are isolated here
+                if self._is_stale(due):
+                    return self._result(due, started_at, EvaluationOutcome.STALE_DISCARDED)
+                detail = "".join(traceback.format_exception_only(type(exc), exc)).strip()
+                return self._result(due, started_at, EvaluationOutcome.ERROR, error_detail=detail)
+
+            if self._is_stale(due):
+                return self._result(due, started_at, EvaluationOutcome.STALE_DISCARDED)
+            outcome, signal, detail = self._normalize_output(raw)
+            return self._result(due, started_at, outcome, signal=signal, error_detail=detail)
+        finally:
+            if acquired:
+                self._semaphore.release()
+            self._pending.get(key, set()).discard(pending)
+            if not self._pending.get(key):
+                self._pending.pop(key, None)
+            if current_task is not None:
+                self._active_submissions.discard(current_task)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _resolve_evaluator(strategy: object) -> Callable[..., object]:
+        evaluate = getattr(strategy, "evaluate", None)
+        candidate = evaluate if callable(evaluate) else strategy
+        if not callable(candidate):
+            raise TypeError("strategy must be callable or provide evaluate()")
+        return candidate
+
+    def _select_executor(
+        self, strategy: object, evaluator: Callable[..., object]
+    ) -> concurrent.futures.Executor:
+        owner = getattr(evaluator, "__self__", None)
+        cpu_heavy = bool(getattr(strategy, "cpu_heavy", getattr(owner, "cpu_heavy", False)))
+        if not (self._process_enabled and cpu_heavy):
+            return self._thread_executor
+        if self._process_executor is None:
+            self._process_executor = concurrent.futures.ProcessPoolExecutor(
+                max_workers=self._process_workers
+            )
+        return self._process_executor
+
+    def _is_stale(self, due: DueEvaluation) -> bool:
+        if due.snapshot_version is None:
+            return False
+        return self._watermarks.get(self.evaluation_key(due), due.snapshot_version) \
+            > due.snapshot_version
+
+    async def _monitor_future(self, future: concurrent.futures.Future[object]) -> None:
+        try:
+            while not future.done():
+                await asyncio.sleep(0.005)
+        finally:
+            self._executor_futures.discard(future)
+            with self._counter_lock:
+                self._in_flight -= 1
+            self._semaphore.release()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    async def _await_future(
+        future: concurrent.futures.Future[object], timeout: float
+    ) -> object:
+        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        deadline = loop.time() + timeout
+        while not future.done():
+            remaining = deadline - loop.time()
+            if remaining <= 0:
+                raise TimeoutError
+            await asyncio.sleep(min(0.005, remaining))
+        return future.result()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _normalize_output(
+        raw: object,
+    ) -> tuple[EvaluationOutcome, object | None, str | None]:
+        if isinstance(raw, Evaluation):
+            if raw.status is EvaluationStatus.SIGNAL:
+                return (EvaluationOutcome.SIGNAL, raw.signal, None)
+            if raw.status is EvaluationStatus.ERROR:
+                return (EvaluationOutcome.ERROR, None, raw.error_detail or raw.reason)
+            return (EvaluationOutcome.NO_SIGNAL, None, raw.reason or None)
+        if raw is None or raw is False:
+            return (EvaluationOutcome.NO_SIGNAL, None, None)
+        return (EvaluationOutcome.SIGNAL, raw, None)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _result(
+        due: DueEvaluation,
+        started_at: datetime,
+        outcome: EvaluationOutcome,
+        *,
+        signal: object | None = None,
+        error_detail: str | None = None,
+    ) -> EvaluationResult:
+        return EvaluationResult(
+            strategy_id=due.strategy_id,
+            side=due.side,
+            symbol=due.symbol,
+            snapshot_version=due.snapshot_version,
+            started_at=started_at,
+            finished_at=datetime.now(UTC),
+            outcome=outcome,
+            signal=signal if outcome is EvaluationOutcome.SIGNAL else None,
+            error_detail=error_detail,
+        )
+
+    async def shutdown(self, *, timeout: float | None = None) -> None:
+        """Stop admission, bound the drain, then release both shared executors."""
+
+        if self._shutdown_complete:
+            return
+        if timeout is not None:
+            self._require_positive_seconds(timeout, "timeout")
+        self._accepting = False
+        bound = self._shutdown_timeout if timeout is None else float(timeout)
+        deadline = asyncio.get_running_loop().time() + bound
+        current = asyncio.current_task()
+        submissions = [task for task in self._active_submissions if task is not current]
+        try:
+            if submissions:
+                await asyncio.wait_for(
+                    asyncio.gather(*submissions, return_exceptions=True),
+                    timeout=max(0.001, deadline - asyncio.get_running_loop().time()),
+                )
+            monitors = tuple(self._monitor_tasks)
+            if monitors:
+                await asyncio.wait_for(
+                    asyncio.gather(*monitors, return_exceptions=True),
+                    timeout=max(0.001, deadline - asyncio.get_running_loop().time()),
+                )
+        except TimeoutError:
+            for future in tuple(self._executor_futures):
+                future.cancel()
+        finally:
+            self._thread_executor.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)
+            if self._process_executor is not None:
+                self._process_executor.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)
+            self._shutdown_complete = True
+
+    async def __aenter__(self) -> EvaluationPool:
+        return self
+
+    async def __aexit__(self, exc_type: object, exc: object, tb: object) -> None:
+        await self.shutdown()

+"""Backpressure and bounded strategy-worker contract tests."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import threading
+import time
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.domain.strategy_types import StrategyRole
+from mike_trade.scheduling.queueing import EventBacklog
+from mike_trade.scheduling.scheduler import DueEvaluation
+from mike_trade.scheduling.triggers import TriggerKind
+from mike_trade.scheduling.workers import (
+    EvaluationOutcome,
+    EvaluationPool,
+    EvaluationPoolClosedError,
+)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class FillEvent:
+    sequence: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class BrokerOrderUpdate:
+    sequence: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class StopEvent:
+    sequence: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ReconciliationEvent:
+    sequence: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class SafetyExitEvent:
+    sequence: int
+
+
+def due(version: int, *, symbol: str = "AAPL", strategy: str = "alpha") -> DueEvaluation:
+    return DueEvaluation(
+        symbol=symbol,
+        strategy_id=strategy,
+        side=StrategyRole.BUY,
+        trigger_kind=TriggerKind.MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL,
+        snapshot_version=version,
+        bar_key=None,
+        due_at=datetime.now(UTC),
+    )
+
+
+async def test_snapshot_flood_keeps_only_latest_version() -> None:
+    backlog = EventBacklog(critical_maxsize=1, coalescible_maxsize=1)
+    for version in range(1, 101):
+        assert await backlog.put(due(version))
+
+    assert backlog.qsize() == 1
+    assert (await backlog.get()).snapshot_version == 100
+    assert backlog.stats.coalesced == 99
+    assert backlog.watermark("AAPL") == 100
+
+
+async def test_critical_events_survive_market_data_flood_in_fifo_order() -> None:
+    backlog = EventBacklog(critical_maxsize=2, coalescible_maxsize=1)
+    events = [FillEvent(1), BrokerOrderUpdate(2), StopEvent(3),
+              ReconciliationEvent(4), SafetyExitEvent(5)]
+    received: list[object] = []
+
+    async def consume() -> None:
+        while len([item for item in received if not isinstance(item, DueEvaluation)]) < 5:
+            received.append(await backlog.get())
+
+    consumer = asyncio.create_task(consume())
+    for version, event in enumerate(events, 1):
+        await backlog.put(due(version))
+        await backlog.put(event)
+    await consumer
+
+    critical = [item for item in received if not isinstance(item, DueEvaluation)]
+    assert critical == events
+    assert backlog.stats.coalesced + backlog.stats.discarded >= 1
+
+
+async def test_full_critical_queue_backpressures_instead_of_dropping() -> None:
+    backlog = EventBacklog(critical_maxsize=1, coalescible_maxsize=1)
+    first, second = FillEvent(1), FillEvent(2)
+    await backlog.put(first)
+    blocked = asyncio.create_task(backlog.put(second))
+    await asyncio.sleep(0)
+    assert not blocked.done()
+    assert backlog.stats.backpressure == 1
+    assert backlog.stats.overflow == 1
+    assert await backlog.get() == first
+    assert await blocked
+    assert await backlog.get() == second

+
+async def test_exception_is_isolated_and_non_signal_outcomes_have_no_signal() -> None:
+    pool = EvaluationPool(max_workers=2, evaluation_timeout=0.05)

+    def broken() -> object:
+        raise RuntimeError("deliberate failure")
+
+    results = await asyncio.gather(
+        pool.submit(due(1), broken),
+        pool.submit(due(1, strategy="ok"), lambda: {"side": "BUY"}),
+    )
+    error, normal = results
+    assert error.outcome is EvaluationOutcome.ERROR
+    assert "deliberate failure" in (error.error_detail or "")
+    assert error.signal is None
+    assert normal.outcome is EvaluationOutcome.SIGNAL
+
+    timeout = await pool.submit(due(2), lambda: time.sleep(0.2), timeout=0.01)
+    assert timeout.outcome is EvaluationOutcome.TIMEOUT
+    assert timeout.signal is None
+    await pool.shutdown(timeout=0.01)
+
+
+async def test_stale_completion_and_pending_supersession() -> None:
+    pool = EvaluationPool(max_workers=1, evaluation_timeout=1)
+    started = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+
+    def slow() -> str:
+        started.set()
+        release.wait(0.5)
+        return "BUY"
+
+    first = asyncio.create_task(pool.submit(due(1), slow))
+    for _ in range(40):
+        if started.is_set():
+            break
+        await asyncio.sleep(0.005)
+    assert started.is_set()
+    pending = asyncio.create_task(pool.submit(due(1, strategy="pending"), lambda: "BUY"))
+    await asyncio.sleep(0)
+    pool.update_watermark("AAPL", "alpha", StrategyRole.BUY, 2)
+    pool.update_watermark("AAPL", "pending", StrategyRole.BUY, 2)
+    release.set()
+
+    stale, cancelled = await asyncio.gather(first, pending)
+    assert stale.outcome is EvaluationOutcome.STALE_DISCARDED
+    assert stale.signal is None
+    assert cancelled.outcome is EvaluationOutcome.CANCELLED
+    assert cancelled.signal is None
+    await pool.shutdown()
+
+
+async def test_shared_executor_and_concurrency_cap() -> None:
+    pool = EvaluationPool(max_workers=2, max_in_flight=2)
+    executor_id = id(pool.executor)
+    lock = threading.Lock()
+    active = high_water = 0
+
+    def evaluate() -> None:
+        nonlocal active, high_water
+        with lock:
+            active += 1
+            high_water = max(high_water, active)
+        time.sleep(0.01)
+        with lock:
+            active -= 1
+
+    jobs = [pool.submit(due(1, symbol=f"S{symbol}", strategy=f"s{strategy}"), evaluate)
+            for symbol in range(10) for strategy in range(3)]
+    await asyncio.gather(*jobs)
+    assert high_water <= 2
+    assert pool.in_flight_high_water <= 2
+    assert id(pool.executor) == executor_id
+    assert pool.thread_submissions == 30
+    await pool.shutdown()
+
+
+async def test_process_execution_is_explicit_and_disabled_by_default() -> None:
+    class CpuHeavy:
+        cpu_heavy = True
+
+        def evaluate(self) -> None:
+            return None
+
+    disabled = EvaluationPool(max_workers=1)
+    await disabled.submit(due(1), CpuHeavy())
+    assert disabled.process_executor is None
+    assert disabled.process_submissions == 0
+    await disabled.shutdown()
+
+    # Selection itself is covered without making this unit test depend on a
+    # platform-specific process start method or pickling a local fixture.
+    enabled = EvaluationPool(max_workers=1, enable_process_pool=True)
+    evaluator = enabled._resolve_evaluator(CpuHeavy())
+    selected = enabled._select_executor(CpuHeavy(), evaluator)
+    assert selected is enabled.process_executor
+    await enabled.shutdown()
+
+
+async def test_shutdown_is_bounded_and_rejects_new_work() -> None:
+    pool = EvaluationPool(max_workers=1, evaluation_timeout=0.02, shutdown_timeout=0.05)
+    running = asyncio.create_task(pool.submit(due(1), lambda: time.sleep(0.2)))
+    await asyncio.sleep(0)
+    await pool.shutdown()
+    result = await running
+    assert result.outcome is EvaluationOutcome.TIMEOUT
+    with pytest.raises(EvaluationPoolClosedError):
+        await pool.submit(due(2), lambda: None)

+"""Bounded, priority-aware event backlog for the engine scheduler.
+
+The backlog deliberately owns classification.  Producers submit an event, not a
+priority, so safety-sensitive event types cannot accidentally be made lossy.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+from collections import OrderedDict
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from enum import StrEnum
+from time import monotonic
+
+from mike_trade.scheduling.scheduler import (
+    DueEvaluation,
+    ManualEvaluationRequest,
+    MarketDataArrivalEvent,
+    QuoteChangeEvent,
+)
+
+__all__ = [
+    "EventClass",
+    "EventBacklogStats",
+    "EventBacklog",
+    "BoundedEventBacklog",
+    "classify_event",
+]
+
+
+class EventClass(StrEnum):
+    CRITICAL = "CRITICAL"
+    COALESCIBLE = "COALESCIBLE"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class EventBacklogStats:
+    depth: int
+    critical_depth: int
+    coalescible_depth: int
+    oldest_age_seconds: float
+    coalesced: int
+    discarded: int
+    backpressure: int
+    overflow: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Queued:
+    event: object
+    enqueued_at: float
+
+
+_COALESCIBLE_TYPES = (MarketDataArrivalEvent, QuoteChangeEvent, DueEvaluation,
+                      ManualEvaluationRequest)
+_CRITICAL_TYPE_NAMES = frozenset(
+    {
+        "FillEvent",
+        "OrderUpdateEvent",
+        "TradeUpdate",
+        "BrokerOrderUpdate",
+        "BrokerTradeUpdate",
+        "ReconciliationEvent",
+        "ReconciliationRequest",
+        "ReconciliationDrift",
+        "StopEvent",
+        "StopTriggeredEvent",
+        "ProtectiveEvent",
+        "ProtectionEvent",
+        "SafetyExitEvent",
+        "ManualCloseEvent",
+    }
+)
+_CRITICAL_NAME_PARTS = ("fill", "brokerorder", "brokertrade", "reconcil", "stop",
+                        "protect", "safetyexit", "manualclose")
+
+
+def classify_event(event: object) -> EventClass:
+    """Classify from the concrete event type; callers cannot supply a class."""
+
+    if isinstance(event, _COALESCIBLE_TYPES):
+        return EventClass.COALESCIBLE
+
+    type_name = type(event).__name__
+    normalized = "".join(character for character in type_name.lower() if character.isalnum())
+    if type_name in _CRITICAL_TYPE_NAMES or any(
+        part in normalized for part in _CRITICAL_NAME_PARTS
+    ):
+        return EventClass.CRITICAL
+
+    # Operator close/flatten/reconcile commands are critical.  Other control
+    # commands are intentionally not guessed into either delivery class.
+    command_type = getattr(event, "command_type", None)
+    command_name = str(getattr(command_type, "value", command_type)).upper()
+    if command_name in {"CLOSE_POSITION", "CLOSE_ALL", "FLATTEN", "RECONCILE_NOW"}:
+        return EventClass.CRITICAL
+
+    raise TypeError(f"unsupported scheduling event type: {type(event).__module__}.{type_name}")
+
+
+def _text(value: object) -> str:
+    return str(getattr(value, "value", value))
+
+
+def _coalescing_key(event: object) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
+    symbol = getattr(event, "symbol", None)
+    strategy_id = getattr(event, "strategy_id", "*")
+    side = getattr(event, "side", "*")
+    if not isinstance(symbol, str) or not symbol.strip():
+        raise ValueError("coalescible events require a symbol")
+    return (symbol.strip().upper(), _text(strategy_id), _text(side))
+
+
+def _snapshot_version(event: object) -> int:
+    version = getattr(event, "snapshot_version", None)
+    if isinstance(version, bool) or not isinstance(version, int) or version < 1:
+        raise ValueError("coalescible events require a positive snapshot_version")
+    return version
+
+
+class EventBacklog:
+    """Two-class bounded asynchronous backlog.
+
+    Critical FIFO capacity and coalescible-key capacity are independently
+    bounded.  Critical puts wait when full.  A coalescible put replaces the
+    pending item for its key, while a new key waits if the key capacity is full.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, *, critical_maxsize: int = 128, coalescible_maxsize: int = 128) -> None:
+        if isinstance(critical_maxsize, bool) or critical_maxsize < 1:
+            raise ValueError("critical_maxsize must be a positive integer")
+        if isinstance(coalescible_maxsize, bool) or coalescible_maxsize < 1:
+            raise ValueError("coalescible_maxsize must be a positive integer")
+        self._critical: asyncio.Queue[_Queued] = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=critical_maxsize)
+        self._coalescible_maxsize = coalescible_maxsize
+        self._coalescible: OrderedDict[tuple[str, str, str], _Queued] = OrderedDict()
+        self._watermarks: dict[str, int] = {}
+        self._changed = asyncio.Event()
+        self._space = asyncio.Condition()
+        self._coalesced = 0
+        self._discarded = 0
+        self._backpressure = 0
+        self._overflow = 0
+
+    @property
+    def critical_maxsize(self) -> int:
+        return self._critical.maxsize
+
+    @property
+    def coalescible_maxsize(self) -> int:
+        return self._coalescible_maxsize
+
+    @property
+    def watermarks(self) -> dict[str, int]:
+        return dict(self._watermarks)
+
+    def watermark(self, symbol: str) -> int | None:
+        return self._watermarks.get(symbol.strip().upper())
+
+    def qsize(self) -> int:
+        return self._critical.qsize() + len(self._coalescible)
+
+    def empty(self) -> bool:
+        return self.qsize() == 0
+
+    @property
+    def stats(self) -> EventBacklogStats:
+        now = monotonic()
+        timestamps = [item.enqueued_at for item in tuple(self._critical._queue)]  # noqa: SLF001
+        timestamps.extend(item.enqueued_at for item in self._coalescible.values())
+        return EventBacklogStats(
+            depth=self.qsize(),
+            critical_depth=self._critical.qsize(),
+            coalescible_depth=len(self._coalescible),
+            oldest_age_seconds=max(0.0, now - min(timestamps)) if timestamps else 0.0,
+            coalesced=self._coalesced,
+            discarded=self._discarded,
+            backpressure=self._backpressure,
+            overflow=self._overflow,
+        )
+
+    def health(self) -> EventBacklogStats:
+        return self.stats
+
+    async def put(self, event: object) -> bool:
+        """Enqueue *event*; return False only for an obsolete snapshot."""
+
+        event_class = classify_event(event)
+        if event_class is EventClass.CRITICAL:
+            if self._critical.full():
+                self._backpressure += 1
+                self._overflow += 1
+            await self._critical.put(_Queued(event, monotonic()))
+            self._changed.set()
+            return True
+
+        key = _coalescing_key(event)
+        version = _snapshot_version(event)
+        symbol = key[0]
+        watermark = self._watermarks.get(symbol, 0)
+        current = self._coalescible.get(key)
+        current_version = _snapshot_version(current.event) if current is not None else 0
+        if version < max(watermark, current_version):
+            self._discarded += 1
+            return False
+        self._watermarks[symbol] = max(watermark, version)
+
+        if current is not None:
+            if version == current_version:
+                self._discarded += 1
+                return False
+            self._coalescible[key] = _Queued(event, monotonic())
+            self._coalesced += 1
+            self._changed.set()
+            return True
+
+        async with self._space:
+            if len(self._coalescible) >= self._coalescible_maxsize:
+                self._backpressure += 1
+                self._overflow += 1
+            await self._space.wait_for(
+                lambda: len(self._coalescible) < self._coalescible_maxsize
+            )
+            # Another producer may have installed this key while we waited.
+            current = self._coalescible.get(key)
+            if current is not None:
+                current_version = _snapshot_version(current.event)
+                if version <= current_version:
+                    self._discarded += 1
+                    return False
+                self._coalesced += 1
+            self._coalescible[key] = _Queued(event, monotonic())
+        self._changed.set()
+        return True
+
+    async def get(self) -> object:
+        """Return the next item, always draining safety-critical FIFO work first."""
+
+        while True:
+            try:
+                queued = self._critical.get_nowait()
+                if self.empty():
+                    self._changed.clear()
+                return queued.event
+            except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
+                pass
+
+            async with self._space:
+                if self._coalescible:
+                    _, queued = self._coalescible.popitem(last=False)
+                    self._space.notify(1)
+                    if self.empty():
+                        self._changed.clear()
+                    return queued.event
+
+            self._changed.clear()
+            if not self.empty():
+                self._changed.set()
+                continue
+            await self._changed.wait()
+
+    def task_done(self) -> None:
+        """Mark one critical item complete when consumers use queue joins."""
+
+        self._critical.task_done()
+
+    async def join_critical(self) -> None:
+        await self._critical.join()
+
+
+BoundedEventBacklog = EventBacklog
